title: Growing up next to Ann Street Baptist Church
summary: The family lived next door to Ann Street Baptist Church, with Sunday School, the eleven o'clock service and the evening B.Y.P.U. taking up most of Sunday.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: But you know, that was a long time before I could play cards at home.
Well we used to live next door to the church.
What was the church called, do you remember?
Yes, Ann Street Baptist Church. It's still, it's not in the same place but it's down the street. And we used to have to get up and go to Sunday School. Stayed for the morning service, you know.
Was Sunday School before the service?
So how much time would you spend in church on Sunday?
Oh, go to Sunday School and then come back and then go to morning service. Well, morning service started at eleven.
And how long did it go?
It went until about one. So I guess it ran about three hours during that time, for Sunday School and Church. And then in the evening we'd go to

Baptist Young Peoples Union, you know? And it was just, we'll we'd go in and have a little program. It was interesting.
